divisions.headline: Dart Attack wins a 2nd straight, creates amazing four-way logjam; Element fights Beach tooth-and-nail in singles before pulling away in doubles; Appetite races to an 18-0 lead
Kids roll the red-hot Birds to solidify hold on first; Inconsistent and Possee post solid wins, move into 3rd & 4th
Menace, ever unpredictable, blows an 11-5 lead on Projectile to really open up the race for 2nd; Secrets ease by the Ducks to move up to 3rd; Hump'N jumps into the win column
Rally, Knights, and Sanchez all win, now too far ahead of the pack to be caught; Stumble gets a big 1001 victory
What's the Point sweeps doubles to escape Arrows; Blanks win a shorthanded battle over Mayhem to stay in 2nd; shorthanded Corks run all over Dartness in the battle for 3rd
Cheapies handle the Shooters, as standings would predict (which rarely happens in hot mess F); Death Throw rides DCkt sweep past She Said; Nein Mark jumps on Two Time early
Machine closes out Rippin in DCkt, making for the 3rd loss in the last 4 for Rippin; We Throw It downs Flight Club, creating a pretty amazing 2nd-6th logjam spread by only one win
Vision sweeps two sets from Afraid (and also won the one missing week 8 match); SofaKings finally run away from The Blind after sitting tied at 8-8; Dirty Darts eke by Bright Side
